title: As You Like It

vibeProfile.oneLine: A banished, disguised Rosalind schools her beloved in a forest.

summary: Banished to the Forest of Arden, the quick-witted Rosalind disguises herself as a boy and, from behind that disguise, playfully schools the man she loves in the art of love. Shakespeare's sunniest pastoral comedy is a witty, generous romp about disguise, desire and the freedom of the greenwood, and contains the famous 'All the world's a stage' speech. Charming and clever, it gives Rosalind one of the largest and most delightful roles Shakespeare ever wrote for a woman.
whyReadIt: Shakespeare's sunniest comedy, with Rosalind, one of his greatest heroines, running rings around everyone. 'All the world's a stage' lives here.

funFacts.text: The famous 'All the world's a stage' monologue comes from this play.
